thread:
Nora: Heads-up from Helio partner ops. They're seeing sporadic zero-usage windows after their compact job runs. Example: partner sent a compacted file for window 2026-03-10T11:00Z but our ledger shows 0 for multiple customers. Ticket: https://helio.partner/TCK-550
Vik: do we have the partner payload sample?
Nora: pasted redacted: {"partner":"helio","window":"2026-03-10T11:00Z","compact_summary":[{"cust":"h-42","units":0}],"sig":"abc123"}
Sam: zero units in summary could mean compaction collapsed small customers. Did they include an absolute snapshot or only deltas?
Nora: only summaries. Helio assumed we keep raw events. They also use a rotating signing key which may cause signature verification failures on replay attempts.
Vik: two quick fixes: (1) ingress change - if compact_summary contains entries with units==0, mark window "compacted-empty" instead of writing zero usage; surface it to partnerships queue. (2) build a replay acceptance endpoint that supports key rotation: accept manifest signed by any key in partner's keyset with key_id header.
Sam: also add a verification signal: if signature verification fails for a replay, return 409 with header X-Replay-Error:signature_mismatch and instructions. Don't auto-mark as zero. That avoids accidental zeroing.
Nora: billing-bot, how many customers hit compacted-empty for Helio in last 60 days?
billing-bot: Query queued: SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marketplace_usage WHERE partner='helio' AND received_at >= '2026-01-30' AND payload_flag='compacted_empty'; estimated rows: 19
Vik: action items: Sam to implement ingress tombstone state + 409 header; Nora to craft partner comms requiring manifests & key_id for replays; billing team to prepare backfill playbook for 19 customers. We'll accept replays for 14 days if properly signed.
Sam: will open PR today. I'll also add a metric for compacted_empty_rate per partner and set alert >0.5%.
Nora: thanks. Helio asked about SLA for replay window; we counterproposal 14d standard, 45d enterprise with manifest & key rotation proof. They accepted tentative terms and want us to document in onboarding."
